# U13: Anyone sets up a review: name, cadence, goals, people

- **Belongs to:** the Reviews module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `REVIEW-SETUP`, `LEVELS`, `CHANGE-LOG`
- **Budget:** at most 11 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Jun, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U13

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Jun (`jun`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- **Step.** Open “Reviews” from the menu (the sidebar on a computer; the tab bar, or its More, on a phone).
- **Check:** “Platform leadership weekly” is shown.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Set up a review” link is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “reviews”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Set up a review” link.
- Press the “Set up the review” button.
- **Check:** (`errors`) an alert showing “Give the review a name” is visible (else: an unnamed review is not explained).
- **Step.** Type “SRE fortnightly” into the “Name” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Every 4 weeks” button.
- Choose “4” in the “On” search field.
- **Step.** Press the “North star” button.
- _Note:_ People are found by typing (find-and-pick, FS1): the list narrows to the match.
- **Step.** Press the “People” button showing “Choose a person / Add another person”.
- **Step.** Type “Mateo” into the “People” search field.
- **Check:** “match” is shown in the pick count (`.pick-count[role="status"]`).
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `listed <= 3`, where `const listed = await p.getByRole('listbox', { name: 'People' }).getByRole('option').count()`. Else it says: finding “Mateo” left {listed} people in the list.
- **Step.** Press the “Mateo Fernández” option.
- Press the Escape key.
- **Check:** “[2-9] goals so far” is shown (else: the form counts the goals picked).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “set up”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Set up the review” button.
- **Check:** “SRE fortnightly” is shown.
- **Check:** “Every 4 weeks, Fridays” is shown.
- **Check:** (`progress`) the ring (`.ring:visible`) is there (else: the review page has no progress).
- _Note:_ Exceptions are listed; goals on track with nothing flagged are one named group with a count.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `(await p.locator('.agenda .agenda-row').count()) + healthyN >= 2`, where `const healthyN = Number(((await p.locator('.healthy-group .block-title').innerText().catch(() => '')).match(/(\d+)\s*$/) || ['', '0'])[1])`. Else it says: the review does not list its goals.
- **Check:** (`finish`) the “Start review” button is visible or the words “Next:” is visible (else: no way to start the new review).
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `!!r && r.everyWeeks === 4 && r.weekday === 4 && r.people.includes('mateo') && r.people.includes('jun') && s.changes.some((c) => c.entity === 'review' && c.actorId === 'jun')`, where `const s = await h.snapshot()`; `const r = s.reviews.find((x) => x.name === 'SRE fortnightly')`. Else it says: the review is not saved and logged.
- Close this browser.

How to read these lines: [the journeys](../../../core/journeys.md#how-to-read-a-journeys-steps).
